speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you're a newborn presenting with respiratory distress; can you tell me if there were any complications during your delivery, such as prematurity or meconium aspiration? Additionally, are you experiencing any difficulty feeding or cyanosis?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born after the 32nd gestational week. The baby was born via cesarean delivery. The mother had gestational diabetes but was otherwise healthy with no other pregnancy-related diseases.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that history. Given the prematurity and maternal gestational diabetes, have you noticed any signs of jaundice or temperature instability? Also, has the baby had any episodes of apnea or significant lethargy since birth?
